notes:
- You can drop MP3, WAV and other audio files in with your videos, for podcasts recorded on a separate recorder. Each file can be up to 2 TB.
- Every file has a \"Use this file's sound\" box. Tick one or several (they're lined up and mixed); with none ticked, Revive uses the file that sounds clearest.
- Every clip and long-form moment is now mono, so a podcast with one mic on each channel plays both voices in both ears.
